description: NaLa₄N₂I₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a distorted octahedral geometry to six I atoms. There are a spread of Na-I bond distances ranging from 3.08-3.51 Å. There are four inequivalent La sites. In the first La site, La is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two N and four I atoms. There is one shorter (2.35 Å) and one longer (2.36 Å) La-N bond length. There are a spread of La-I bond distances ranging from 3.19-3.40 Å. In the second La site, La is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two N and six I atoms. There is one shorter (2.36 Å) and one longer (2.39 Å) La-N bond length. There are a spread of La-I bond distances ranging from 3.28-3.95 Å. In the third La site, La is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two N and four I atoms. There is one shorter (2.34 Å) and one longer (2.36 Å) La-N bond length. There are a spread of La-I bond distances ranging from 3.22-3.49 Å. In the fourth La site, La is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two N and five I atoms. Both La-N bond lengths are 2.38 Å. There are a spread of La-I bond distances ranging from 3.27-3.88 Å. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded to four La atoms to form edge-sharing NLa₄ tetrahedra. In the second N site, N is bonded to four La atoms to form edge-sharing NLa₄ tetrahedra. There are seven inequivalent I sites. In the first I site, I is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two La atoms. In the second I site, I is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two La atoms. In the third I site, I is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two La atoms. In the fourth I site, I is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two La atoms. In the fifth I site, I is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na and three La atoms. In the sixth I site, I is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four La atoms. In the seventh I site, I is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na and four La atoms.
